dashboard.name: NutsNews Backend - Logs - Diagnostics
dashboard.description: 24 hour dashboard for structured backend log severity, exceptions, route/status breakdowns, deployment correlation, and trace/request context. Managed from ramideltoro/nutsnews-backend.

pages.name: Log diagnostics
pages.description: Incident-oriented views from parsed structured log fields.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET level TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND level IN ('warning', 'error', 'critical') FACET level TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET deployment.version, level LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND exception.class IS NOT NULL FACET exception.class LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*), average(duration.ms) FROM Log WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET route, http.statusCode LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET host, unit, level LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago

SELECT latest(timestamp), latest(level), latest(request.id), latest(trace.id), latest(message.safe) FROM Log WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND level IN ('error', 'critical') FACET trace.id LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago

rawConfiguration.text: Use severity trend, then route/status and deployment facets. Pivot to APM with request.id or trace.id when present.
